task.title: Connect product context to the existing inquiry form
task.input: model-fallback, the existing InquiryWizard and POST /api/inquiries protocol
task.output: product-inquiry; the context chain from product cards to contact-page inquiries
task.accept: 1) Click product-card inquire-product to /[locale]/contact. A real POST /api/inquiries carries a server-recognized productSlug and persists a real Inquiry identifier; form product/specifications equal the source card, without changing the old inquiry protocol. 2) Use that entry separately in en/ru and at narrow width 390. Model dragging/keyboard control before submission produces no inquiry POST; names, specifications and inquiry entries remain visible and can complete submission. Retain one real-path GIF.
